beats.text: Most people think God turns up when the room is full.
The bigger the crowd, the more real it feels.
Jesus put the number at two.
Where two or three gather together as my followers, I am there among them.
Two. Not twenty. Not two hundred.
The bar is lower than you think it is.
A kitchen table counts. The school run counts.
You don't need to know what you're doing. You need to show up.
Tonight. Two of you. Ten minutes.
